metadata.title: My CV in 30 Seconds — Build your CV with AI
metadata.description: Answer 5 questions and AI writes a professional CV for you in seconds. Start for free.

home.title: Your professional CV <highlight>in seconds</highlight>, ready to get past recruiters' filters.
home.subtitle: Answer 5 questions: the AI writes a clear, well-structured CV that applicant tracking systems can read. Review it, fine-tune it, download it as a PDF.
home.illustrationAlt: A candidate creates a CV on a laptop: the CV is approved in 30 seconds.

wizard.metaDescription: Answer 5 simple questions: AI writes your CV, ready for applicant tracking systems.
wizard.title: Create your CV in 5 questions
wizard.intro: Answer simply, in your own words. AI writes and formats your CV.
wizard.jobRequired: Enter the job you're aiming for to continue.
wizard.shortAnswers: Your answers are short: the more details you give (jobs, tasks, tools, degrees), the more accurate your CV will be.
wizard.languageHint: Your answers can be written in any language: the CV will be written in this one.
wizard.freeHint: Your first generation is free. Your answers stay saved on this device.

job.title: What job are you aiming for?
job.help: The position or profession you're looking for. This is the only required answer.

experiences.title: What is your work experience?
experiences.help: Jobs, companies, dates and main tasks. Write freely: AI organizes everything.
experiences.example:
Web developer at Studio Lumière, Lyon, from 2021 to now: building websites for shops, integrating mockups, client follow-up.
6-month internship at WebAgence in 2020: WordPress site maintenance.

skills.title: What are your skills?
skills.help: Tools, software, languages, know-how and qualities. Separate them with commas or line breaks.
skills.example: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Figma, teamwork, fluent French

education.title: What is your education?
education.example:
Bachelor's degree in Digital Media, University of Manchester, 2020
A-levels, 2017

goal.title: What is your career goal?
goal.help: What you're looking for: type of job, sector, contract, desired career path.
goal.example: Join a product team to build accessible web applications, on a permanent contract in Manchester or remotely.
